name: ai-cms-system
description: AI-Powered Content Management System with microservices architecture

scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:content" "npm run dev:analytics"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: npm run start:backend && npm run start:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd auth && npm install && cd ../ai && npm install && cd ../content && npm install && cd ../analytics && npm install
